content.text: [Wed 2026-05-20 09:56 UTC] Locate the Chrome or Firefox profile directories in the user home.

arguments.command:
set -e
printf 'HOME=%s\n' "$HOME"
printf '\nStandard browser profile dirs under HOME:\n'
for d in \
  "$HOME/.config/google-chrome" \
  "$HOME/.config/chromium" \
  "$HOME/.mozilla/firefox" \
  "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Google/Chrome" \
  "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Chromium" \
  "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Firefox/Profiles" \
  "$HOME/AppData/Local/Google/Chrome/User Data" \
  "$HOME/AppData/Roaming/Mozilla/Firefox/Profiles"; do
  [ -e "$d" ] && printf '%s\n' "$d"
done
printf '\nDetected Chrome/Chromium profile directories (Preferences present):\n'
find "$HOME" -path '*/Default/Preferences' -o -path '*/Profile */Preferences' -o -path '*/Guest Profile/Preferences' 2>/dev/null | sed 's#/Preferences$##' | sort
printf '\nDetected Firefox profile directories (prefs.js present under .mozilla/firefox):\n'
find "$HOME/.mozilla/firefox" -maxdepth 2 -type f -name prefs.js 2>/dev/null | sed 's#/prefs.js$##' | sort || true
printf '\nFirefox profiles.ini files:\n'
find "$HOME" -path '*/.mozilla/firefox/profiles.ini' -o -path '*/Firefox/profiles.ini' 2>/dev/null | sort
